ex.s: One day in February 1824,at his little house in Vienna, Austria, Ludwig van 15 Beethovensat back in his chair and smiled.Thefamous German composer's ninth symphony was finally completed.
ex.t: 1824年2月的一天,在他位于奥地利维也纳的小房子里,路德维希·范·15·贝特霍文萨特回到椅子上微笑. 著名的德国作曲家的第九交响乐最终完成.
